data.name: Shyamveer
data.gender_notes: Shyamveer is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Shyamveer is a compound name consisting of two Sanskrit words: 'Shyam' meaning 'dark blue' and 'veer' meaning 'hero' or 'warrior'. This name is often associated with Lord Krishna, who is known as the 'God of Gods'. Shyamveer is a powerful and courageous name, symbolizing strength, protection, and the power of nature. The name Shyamveer carries the meaning “God of Gods, Dark Blue” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shyamveer usually hope their child will grow to embody god of gods, dark blue and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine power of Lord Krishna, the embodiment of love, wisdom, and strength. It is a reminder of the inner power and courage that we all possess.
